cloud_model.description: Cloud Gemini model used when CiteReady falls back to (or chooses) the cloud.

on_device_max_chars.description: Largest slice of page text sent to Gemini Nano in one prompt (on-device requests are capped at 9,216 tokens including instructions and output).

max_private_chunks.description: How many on-device chunks a long PRIVATE draft may be split into before CiteReady asks for consent to use the cloud.

mask_contacts_for_cloud.description: When a private draft is sent to the cloud with consent, replace emails and phone numbers with placeholders first.

prompt_version.description: Shown in the route log so prompt changes can be traced.
